global_style: A traditional, poetic template defined by vertical typography, stark high-contrast split backgrounds, and heavy use of organic decorative accents.

identity_anchors: Vertical text orientation for both headers and body copy
Harsh, edge-to-edge color splits (50/50 horizontal or 20/80 vertical)
Circular containers used as numbers, icons, or primary text bounds
High-contrast minimalist environments (pure white against deep slate blue)
Organic, borderless graphic accents that bleed across geometric grid lines

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
